Tiffany & Co (NYSE:TIF): Goldman Sachs Reiterates Buy Rating Today, Has a Target of $136.0000/Share
 Migdalia James Tiffany & Co (NYSE:TIF) Rating Reaffirmed
Analysts at Goldman Sachs now has a $136.0000 target price per share on Tiffany & Co (NYSE:TIF) . Goldman Sachs and their recent target price per share would indicate a potential upside of 49.45 % from the company’s last stock close. The rating has been revealed to clients and investors in a research note on Thursday, 29 November. Tiffany & Co. (NYSE:TIF) Ratings Coverage
Among 10 analysts covering Tiffany ( NYSE:TIF ), 5 have Buy rating, 0 Sell and 5 Hold. Therefore 50% are positive. Tiffany has $165 highest and $9600 lowest target. $123.11’s average target is 35.29% above currents $91 stock price. Tiffany had 12 analyst reports since June 7, 2018 according to SRatingsIntel. On Thursday, November 29 the stock rating was maintained by KeyBanc Capital Markets with “Buy”. KeyBanc Capital Markets maintained the stock with “Overweight” rating in Wednesday, August 29 report. The stock of Tiffany & Co. (NYSE:TIF) earned “Buy” rating by Goldman Sachs on Thursday, November 29. The firm has “Hold” rating by Edward Jones given on Thursday, June 21. The rating was maintained by Loop Capital Markets on Wednesday, November 28 with “Buy”. The firm has “Hold” rating given on Thursday, November 29 by Bank of America. The firm has “Outperform”rating given on Wednesday, August 29 by Credit Suisse. The company was upgraded on Wednesday, September 12 by Oppenheimer.
The stock increased 1.37% or $1.23 during the last trading session, reaching $91. About 4.07M shares traded or 110.28% up from the average. Tiffany & Co. (NYSE:TIF) has risen 29.29% uptrending. It has outperformed by 13.67% the S&P500.
Analysts await Tiffany & Co. (NYSE:TIF) to report earnings on December, 5. They expect $0.76 EPS, down 5.00 % or $0.04 from last year’s $0.8 per share. TIF’s profit will be $93.03 million for 29.93 P/E if the $0.76 EPS becomes a reality. After $1.17 actual EPS reported by Tiffany & Co. for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts -35.04 % negative EPS growth.
Tiffany & Co., through its subsidiaries, designs, makes, and retails jewelry and other items worldwide. The company has market cap of $11.14 billion. The Company’s jewelry products include fine and solitaire jewelry; engagement rings and wedding bands; and non-gemstone, sterling silver, and gold jewelry. It has a 25.22 P/E ratio. The firm also sells timepieces, leather goods, sterling silverware, china, crystal, stationery, fragrances, and accessories.
